text: Shipping options: pick-up (0 €) or size-dependent shipping
description: Two options at checkout. Shipping price tiers by painting dimensions (incl. packaging/girth limits). Needs research: DHL/DPD/GLS/Hermes parcel size limits and prices for large flat items, Sperrgut surcharges, art-shipping services for oversize, insurance. Tiers kept in config.
